The Bachelor of Science in Exercise Science (BSES) program is designed to provide the student with the foundational knowledge regarding the human body as it applies to exercise. This degree also helps prepare students for post-graduate studies in various healthcare professions such as physical therapy, occupational therapy, and athletic training.


  • General Chemistry is articulated as a sequence only; however, for this major, CHE 111 General Chemistry II is not required.
